bibliographic.title: Sandy Isle
bibliographic.author: Telon Tara Telvarost
bibliographic.description:
A very tiny twine story made for the October BareBones Game Jam. I only found about this event halfway through October, but it seemed exactly like the sort of story I would want to write and publish. It was shorter than I hoped it would be, but I am happy with learning the process for making and publishing a work and that it is public so my friends can read it. The story doesn't have a strong plot, so don't expect much from it!

Follow Theriod's visit to the Sanctuary of Melys where the protagonist may choose to embark to a world of light and water using a sapphire key or stay behind and ponder the stars.
